About

One person who can follow a candidate, a lead, and a calendar through to the end.

My work has moved between recruitment, sales calls, front-desk communication, and marketing support. The common thread is people and information: talking with candidates and customers clearly, then recording what was said so the next person can act on it.

At ResultsCX I reviewed applications, ran interviews, and extended offers across several lines of business. At Pickern Allstate Insurance Agency I qualified prospects and booked appointments with licensed agents. At HRTX Consulting I built talent pipelines and prepared recruitment reports. At STI College Batangas I handled inquiries across channels and ran the school's social media.

I'm also a licensed professional teacher with a degree in secondary education, major in English. I'm looking for remote roles where organized follow-through and professional communication matter.

Working with people

Candidates, prospects, guests, enrollees, and hiring managers, by phone, email, social media, and video call.

Managing information

Accurate ATS entries, shared-drive records, call notes, and reports that others can pick up and use.

Adapting quickly

Comfortable learning new platforms, scripts, and processes, and open to coaching along the way.

Project 2

Candidate Sourcing Workflow

Concept · process map

The path a candidate takes from first contact to offer, with the record-keeping step that keeps every handoff clean.

1
SourceJob boards, social media, networks, referrals
2
ReviewApplications, prescreening answers, assessment results
3
ScreenCheck readiness and fit against the client's preferences
4
ScheduleBook the interview and confirm with the candidate
5
DocumentRecord interview results in the ATS and shared drive
6
OfferSend the formal offer and follow up on the reply
Always: keep candidate records currentWarm and cold follow-up: by phone or message until the candidate answers
